english.title: Aircraft commander fail to permit a customs officer to board an aircraft and inspect it / goods / documents
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the commander of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..), failed to permit an officer, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFICER..), to board and inspect it and any

(A)_[goods loaded therein and all documents relating to the aircraft]_
(B)_[goods carried in the aircraft]_
(C)_[persons carried in the aircraft]_
(D)_[**(..WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE ABOVE OPTIONS IS REQUIRED - SPECIFY..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(1) and (4) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
